---
title: Multi-element rendering (project mode)
format: q2-preview
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      requires_js: true
    q2-preview:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # must-match — same as multi-element-doc.qmd; this fixture
        # exercises the project pass-2 renderer path
        # (pass2_renderer.rs::RenderToPreviewAstRenderer) which would
        # otherwise go untested for CustomNode rendering.
        -
          - 'div.callout-note > div.callout-header > div.callout-title-container.flex-fill'
          - 'div.callout-note > div.callout-body-container.callout-body'
          - 'div.theorem > p > span.theorem-title > strong'
          - 'a.quarto-xref'
          - 'span#eq-einstein'
          - 'a.footnote-ref'
          # The native HTML writer emits `<section id="footnotes" class="footnotes section">`
          # for the footnotes container; bd-coffj closed q2-preview's parity gap so
          # `Div` blocks carrying the `section` class also render as `<section>`,
          # not `<div>`. The selector must match the native output.
          - 'div#quarto-appendix > section#footnotes'
        # must-not-match — no fallback, no raw CustomNode wrappers
        -
          - 'div.q2-preview-placeholder'
          - 'div[data-custom-type]'

# Multi-element rendering (project)

::: {.callout-note}
Heads up — project-mode rendering must produce the same DOM as
single-doc mode.
:::

::: {#thm-pythagoras .theorem}
For a right triangle with legs of length $a$ and $b$ and hypotenuse $c$,
$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.
:::

The Pythagorean identity is stated in @thm-pythagoras.
